title: MCA's Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS-2026) Closes: Advisory for Defaulting Companies
content:
# MCA's Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS-2026) Closes: Advisory for Defaulting Companies

Ek important update hai. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ki Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) ab band ho chuki hai. Is scheme ki validity, jo General Circular No. 04/2026 dated August 31, 2026, ke through extend ki gayi thi, 15 September 2026 ko khatam ho gayi hai. Yeh last extension thi, so defaulting companies ko ab next steps urgently lene honge.

**Key Details:**

*   **Scheme Name:** Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026)
*   **Final Closure Date:** September 15, 2026
*   **Extending Circular:** General Circular No. 04/2026 dated August 31, 2026

**What Next for Defaulting Companies?**

From September 16, 2026, the normal regime for additional fees has resumed. Iska matlab hai ki ab pending statutory filings par standard additional fees lagengi, jo pehle scheme mein available substantial relief (usually 10% of additional fees) se kafi zyada hongi.

Companies जिन्होंने CCFS-2026 ka benefit nahi liya ya filings complete nahi ki, unhe ab Companies Act, 2013 ke provisions ke according consequences face karne pad sakte hain, jisme Registrar of Companies (ROC) dwara action, prosecution, aur even director disqualification under Section 164(2) shamil ho sakte hain.

Agar aapki company ki filings abhi bhi pending hain, toh best course of action yahi hai ki jald se jald unhe complete kiya jaye, even at the normal additional fees, to avoid further penalties and legal complications.
